test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five students are sitting in a circle facing the center. Sumit is between Sunil and Sushmit. Sushma is on the left side of Shweta, Sushmit and Sushma are not sitting next to each other. Who is sitting next to Sumit on his right side?
solution:
Five students are sitting in a circle facing the center.

1. Sumit is between Sunil and Sushmit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07bfc861ec36c36238dc8191c783da1f2ec151bd07137ce25bfe8190412f96b5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad1b284b893040f70961a64d8a889807b623f43edf1ca113f9e613d9de16fb6.png] 

2. Sushma is on the left side of Shweta, Sushmit and Sushma are not sitting next to each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d915448dc4510f39bf024b368866eb09e295af25e11a60751d32778fb11dd422.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54e948eb01660fc40524ce00c6e1a9b1d804ad9cf5bdbab7e3b065327de5017e.png] 

Here case II will be eliminated.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d915448dc4510f39bf024b368866eb09e295af25e11a60751d32778fb11dd422.png] 

Clearly, Sunil is sitting next to Sumit on his right side.

Hence, ‘**Sunil**’ is the correct answer.
